limitations: Remote core execution uses a controlled adapter. No actual private RPC/payload, negotiated remote recipe capability, one-use worker operation ledger or daemon recipe adapter is enabled.
RemoteRecipeTarget constructor validates shape only. A trusted adapter must derive complete stamps from actual live channel/worker boot/turn/export/grant/checkout and check them at every use.
Remote server authority and recipe catalog support remain unsupported until the private adapter and session-level catalog preflight are integrated. Tools/list must not invent an active turn.
Local runtime regression uses production relay/proxy/bubblewrap with controlled keyring and HTTP substitutes; it does not attest an actual remote recipe process.

RemoteRecipePlan has no controller path/cwd and no Deserialize. Typed executor mismatch is denied before secret read; adapters must still attest the target and retain live cancellation/redaction through real execution.
A redaction method is supplied for trusted adapter use before response; future wire/daemon integration must actually enforce this. Controller repeats redaction before publishing.
No Chromium rerun, real account/service/tailnet, native macOS or private remote CLI acceptance.
Workflow/service use, extra assets/linked metadata, E5.3/E10 and full project checklist remain open21/68.
